question: Which English dataset do they evaluate on?
requirements: Name the English dataset used for evaluation.
claims: They evaluate on the original MS-COCO English dataset restricted to the sportball category, called 'English-sportball', consisting of 3,850 sportball images, which is first evaluated to provide base results for the following comparisons.

Their experiments and comparisons are conducted through three datasets of the same size and sportball images: two Vietnamese datasets (Google-translated and human-annotated) and the original MS-COCO English dataset, split into 2,695 training, 924 validation and 231 test images.

The English dataset used for comparison is the original MS-COCO (Microsoft Common in Objects in Context) dataset, whose English captions categorized with sportball were used to train the Pytorch-tutorial and NIC Show-and-Tell models.
